entities.justification: Named as the cited defendant ('citata', 'Conuentam', 'debitrice') and identified at the end as 'praedictae Barbarae citata'.
Identified as the absent legal guardian and advocate ('Ferendarium suum', 'tutor et Prolocutor') of Barbara.
The consular council of Lviv issuing court decrees and appointing a guardian.
Council apparitor/court usher ('Ostiarium') appointed by the council as guardian ('Tutore') to Barbara.
The plaintiff ('Actor') and creditor pursuing execution/division of property against Barbara.
